question:
I have this code:

{{ config (
    materialized = 'incremental',
    properties = {
        "location": "'s3://iceberg/table_{{trigger.run_started_at}}'
    }

The {{trigger.run_started_at}} doesn't seem to work and it stays as it is.

I need to get something like this:

's3://iceberg/table_2023-01-01
title: How to use Jinja2 inside configs?
answer:
I believe you shouldn't be nesting double curlies. Does this not work?

{{ config (
    materialized = 'incremental',
    properties = "location": "'s3://iceberg_test/my_table_" ~ run_started_at ~ "'"
}}

If so, you can use macros in the config. So you can use something like env_var() or any custom macro. You wouldn't use double curly braces or anything to call it.

{{ config (
    materialized = 'incremental',
    properties = get_location()
}}

You could then write the macro to return the expected data-type (map/dict)
